Team —

Quick regional reminder as we head into the week: finance needs a firm commit and stage-cleanup for all EMEA/APAC opportunities by EOD Wednesday so the FP&A rollup can land on Thursday morning. Please do the following for any deals closing in the next 90 days: 

- Verify stage in HubSpot matches current commercial ask (i.e., MQL/SQL->Commit/Contract Sent).
- Move stale opportunities (no contact in 30+ days) to Park or mark as Lost with reason.
- Attach the latest mutual action plan or procurement notes to the deal.

I've attached an EMEA rollup template (EMEA_Q2_rollup.xlsx) and an APAC commit matrix for your use. Two quick asks: 1) Put the one-line commit on the deal record (amount, close date, blocker) and 2) drop a one-line update in reply to this thread for anything > $50k.

Examples: 
- NordicTel — Commit $85k, legal signoff pending (Danielle handling procurement).
- APACCloud — Probable $120k, awaiting PO from Sophie (local billing team).

If you have pipeline oddities (split-sourced, credit asks, multi-region contracts) copy me + Rishi so we can bake it into the forecast.

Thanks —
Marissa
Marissa Cole
